name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns, with no data handling of its own. The two callees are unnamed in the executable, so the wrapper only sequences them.

name: write_masked_bytes_to_planes
description: Reads eight bytes from a global table selected by the low byte of the data register and ANDs each one with a global mask. Each result is written to the same row of all four bitplanes, whose base addresses come from a record, with the row offset built from two position bytes and advancing 40 per row.

name: copy_pattern_to_plane
description: Copies eight bytes from a global table, selected by the low byte of the data register, into one bitplane without masking. The destination is the two position bytes combined as a 320-wide offset, added to a base address read through a global pointer, advancing 40 per row.

name: call_per_character_of_string
description: Calls one routine once, then calls another routine for each byte of a zero-terminated string addressed by an address register, stopping at the terminating zero. It returns zero.

name: set_object_position_to_24
description: Calls one routine, then stores 24 into both position bytes of the current record. The two bytes are the horizontal and vertical position fields.

name: increment_object_x_position
description: Calls one routine with a pointer argument and another routine with none, then adds one to the horizontal position byte of the record. The pointer is the same on both sides of a comparison against 29, so the branch has no effect.

name: scatter_source_to_planes
description: Runs eight rows, reading one byte per row from each of four source planes spaced eight bytes apart. Each byte is copied into its matching bitplane, whose address comes from record pointers, advancing 40 bytes per row with no masking.

name: call_nine_times_then_store
description: Calls one routine, calls another routine nine times in a row, calls it once more, then writes a fixed 32-bit constant into a global variable.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns. The callees are unnamed, and the routine reads or writes no data of its own.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no data handling of its own. It is a thin pass-through wrapper.

name: clear_bitplane_block_rows
description: Zeroes 22 bytes per row across four bitplanes for 176 consecutive rows. Rows start 480 bytes into the planes, which is 12 rows at a 40-byte stride, and only those 22 bytes of each row are cleared.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no data handling of its own. It is a thin pass-through wrapper.

name: clear_buffer_with_blitter
description: Calls the graphics library's BltClear routine with a buffer pointer taken from a record, a length of 32000 bytes, and a fill value of zero.

name: invert_eight_row_column_indexed
description: Looks up a column offset in a table indexed by a byte in the record, calls one routine, then calls one of two routines chosen by a flag byte in the record. It then bitwise-inverts eight bytes spaced 40 apart at that column in a bitplane addressed through a global pointer.

name: invert_column_at_offset
description: Takes a 16-bit offset from its argument and bitwise-inverts eight bytes spaced 40 apart at that offset in a bitplane addressed through a global pointer. It has no branching or calls.

name: dispatch_on_mode_flag
description: Calls one routine and keeps its result. It then calls a second routine with that result if a flag byte in the record equals one, or calls the first routine again otherwise, then calls a third routine and returns the kept result.

name: dispatch_on_mode_flag
description: Calls one routine and keeps its result. It then calls a second routine with that result if a flag byte in the record equals one, or calls the first routine again otherwise, then calls a third routine and returns the kept result.

name: forward_call_returning_result
description: Calls one other routine and returns its two-register result unchanged. It adds no data handling of its own.

name: call_then_increment_x_position
description: Calls one routine, then adds one to the horizontal position byte of the record.

name: call_twice_then_advance_x
description: Calls one routine twice, then adds one to the horizontal position byte of the record.

name: call_then_increment_x_position
description: Calls one routine, then adds one to the horizontal position byte of the record.

name: multiply_word_by_64
description: Returns its 16-bit argument multiplied by 64, done by shifting it left six bits. It touches no memory and makes no calls.

name: clear_buffer_then_copy_blocks
description: Zeroes 256 bytes of a global buffer, then repeatedly calls one routine and copies 64 bytes from the address in one address register to the address in another. It repeats while the data register returned by that routine is nonzero.

name: copy_blocks_reverse_until_zero
description: Repeatedly calls one routine, then copies 64 bytes from the address in address register zero to the address in address register one. It repeats while the data register returned by that routine is nonzero.

name: decode_digit_code_stream
description: Reads byte codes from a routine in a loop. Codes 176 to 185 become digit values 0 to 9 stored in a record field and advance the horizontal position, code 136 moves the horizontal position back, and code 141 ends the loop by writing two values derived from the digit field into other record fields.

name: decode_digit_code_stream_preloaded
description: Starts from a code already in the data register, then reads further codes in a loop until code 141. Codes 136 and 176 to 185 each call a routine and change the horizontal position, and the loop ends by writing values derived from a digit field into other record fields.

name: decode_digit_code_stream_entry
description: Is the entry point of the same code decoder, checking codes 176 to 185 first and then reading codes until 141. The loop ends by writing values derived from a digit field into other record fields.

name: pack_digit_fields_into_record
description: Multiplies one digit field by ten by repeated addition, adds a second field to the product, and stores the sum in one record field. It also stores the second field plus sixteen times the first into another record field.

name: reduce_routine_result_modulo
description: Stores its argument as a divisor in one record field, then takes a value from a routine and reduces it by repeated subtraction until it is below the divisor. The remainder is written back into that field.

name: call_six_routines_in_order
description: Calls six other routines in sequence and returns, with no data handling of its own.

name: decrement_two_countdown_fields
description: Decrements two countdown byte fields of the record, at offsets 32 and 33. When either reaches zero it is reset to 2 and a routine is called first, and a routine is also called after each step.

name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls three other routines in sequence and returns, with no data handling of its own.

name: decrement_counter_reset_three
description: Decrements the byte field at offset 34 of the record. When it reaches zero it is reset to 3 and one routine is called.

name: decrement_counter_reset_two
description: Decrements the byte field at offset 35 of the record. When it reaches zero it is reset to 2 and one routine is called.

name: decrement_counter_reset_one
description: Decrements the byte field at offset 36 of the record. When it reaches zero it is reset to 1 and two routines are called.

name: exchange_masked_word_pairs
description: When a flag byte in the record is set, it reads two offsets and two masks from a table indexed by the data word. It then goes through four rows at a 32-byte stride, exchanging bits between two words under those masks, and does nothing when the flag is clear.

name: rotate_eight_global_words_left
description: Calls one routine, then rotates eight 16-bit words in a global area left by one bit each, with bit 15 wrapping to bit 0.

name: rotate_eight_record_words_left
description: Rotates left by one bit each of eight 16-bit words at fixed offsets in a record addressed by an address register, with bit 15 wrapping to bit 0.

name: decrement_sign_magnitude_bytes
description: Walks 121 bytes of a global array, decrementing the 7-bit magnitude of each while keeping its sign bit. When a magnitude underflows it calls one routine, keeps the low four bits of the value returned, and rebuilds the byte with a sign bit taken from a register set by that call.

name: walk_string_at_position
description: Stores two argument values as the record's horizontal and vertical position bytes, then walks a zero-terminated string calling one routine per byte. Ordinary bytes also advance the horizontal position by one, while the byte 255 calls the routine without advancing.

name: return_field_times_64
description: Returns the byte at offset 102 of the record multiplied by 64, as a 16-bit value. It makes no calls.

name: write_string_centered_at_row
description: Stores a column computed as 31 minus half the length of a zero-terminated string into the horizontal position byte, and a row computed as the vertical field times 4 plus 1. It then calls one routine per character and advances the horizontal position by one after each.

name: stub_return_only
description: Does nothing and returns; the routine is an empty stub.

name: copy_position_and_lookup_grid
description: Copies the first two bytes of the record into offsets 2 and 3, then returns the global table byte at the first copied value plus the second copied value times 64.

name: lookup_grid_value_at_position
description: Returns the global table byte at the record's offset 2 plus offset 3 times 64, a 64-wide grid lookup.

name: cycle_counter_then_call_three
description: Decrements the byte at offset 37; when it goes negative it resets it to 8 and updates the byte at offset 59 from a routine value, reducing that value by four while it stays at or above five and equals the current byte. It then saves the horizontal position, sets it to 6 and the vertical position to 24, calls three routines, and restores the horizontal position.

name: test_field_eleven_equals_22
description: Returns 255 when the byte at offset 11 of the record equals 22 and either the data register byte matches the byte at offset 59 or that byte is zero, otherwise returns 0.

name: add_multibyte_counter_with_carry
description: Adds a separate global byte into a global array with a carry, working from element 14 down to element 0. It then adds one to element 15 and carries toward element 0 while elements wrap to zero, and returns the first byte of the array.

name: add_bcd_field_with_adjust
description: Adds the byte at offset 75 to the byte at offset 87 of the record and decimal-adjusts the sum, storing it back. It then decimal-adjusts the bytes at offsets 84 to 86 without storing changed values.

name: store_two_bytes_then_loop
description: Stores two argument bytes at offsets 26 and 27 of the record, then repeatedly calls three routines in a loop whose exit test is constant, so it only ends if a callee does not return. A final routine is called after the loop.

name: shift_history_on_countdown_zero
description: Decrements a global countdown byte. When it reaches zero it sets the countdown to the value from the last slot of a seven-entry global history, shifts the history by one slot toward the end, and puts 45 into the first slot.

name: compute_grid_then_draw_cells
description: Only the start of this routine's body is present in the bundle, and the rest is cut off. The visible part fills an 11-by-11 grid in a global array from record bytes, passes over it comparing cell codes with fixed values, and then draws 16-row cell patterns into four bitplanes from lookup tables.

name: draw_cell_grid_wait_vblank
description: Draws an 11-by-11 grid of cells from a global array into four bitplanes, using 16-row pattern data from lookup tables for each cell. It then decrements a countdown and calls one routine when it reaches zero, calls another routine, and waits for the vertical blank.

name: rewrite_array_draw_cell_grid
description: Passes over 121 bytes of a global array and rewrites each one, changing only values in a range that cannot occur, so the array is effectively unchanged. It then draws an 11-by-11 grid of cells into four bitplanes from lookup tables, decrements a countdown, calls one routine at zero, and waits for the vertical blank.

name: dereference_table_pointer_byte
description: Looks up a pointer in a global table with four bytes per entry, indexed by the argument, and returns the byte it points to in the low half of the result.

name: tick_countdown_and_wait_vblank
description: Decrements a global countdown and calls one routine when it reaches zero. It then calls a second routine and waits for the vertical blank.

name: rotate_four_word_blocks
description: Rotates each of four consecutive 16-word blocks by one word toward higher addresses, wrapping each block's last word to its start. The blocks begin at an offset held in a data register, 32 bytes apart.

name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls three other routines in sequence and returns, with no data handling of its own.

name: poll_fire_button_codes
description: Reads the fire button bit from the CIA port register and the right and middle button bits from the pot register, then returns a button code. Depending on state it returns a code with the high bit set, a different code when a record byte equals 22, or zero, and it updates a held-state byte in the record.

name: return_global_byte_at_index
description: Returns the byte of a global table at the index given in the data register, with no other work. Its facts list a CIA port register access that the body does not show.

name: set_flag_negative_if_zero
description: If a global flag byte is zero, sets it to minus one and calls one routine. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: clear_flag_then_call
description: If a global flag byte is nonzero, sets it to zero and calls one routine. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: test_point_in_rectangle_passthrough
description: Tests whether the point held in two data registers lies inside the four-word rectangle addressed by an address register. It returns the byte in the data register unchanged whether or not the point is inside.

name: check_point_in_rectangle
description: Tests whether a point held in two data registers lies inside the four-word rectangle addressed by an address register. It returns nothing and has no effect in either outcome.

name: update_region_index_from_coordinates
description: Maps two global coordinates to a 21-column region index, taking offsets from record bytes or constants chosen by a mode byte. The last inputs and index are cached so unchanged inputs return early, and a change stores a byte from a table and calls one routine; in one mode it stores 5 instead.

name: invalidate_cache_and_call
description: Sets the cached region index to minus one so the next update recomputes it, then calls one routine. It calls a second routine as well when the mode byte equals one.

name: compute_region_index_from_registers
description: Maps two coordinates passed in data registers to a region index with the same logic as the global-based version, using a mode byte and a cache that lets unchanged inputs return early. When the index changes it stores a byte from a table and calls one routine.

name: set_flag_five_and_call
description: If a global byte is not five, sets it to five and calls one routine.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no data handling of its own.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no data handling of its own.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: The decompiled body shows only one call and a return, although the routine spans 160 instructions. The rest of the routine is not visible in the bundle.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no data handling of its own.

name: build_absolute_jump_table
description: Writes 20 entries at six-byte steps into a global area. Each entry is a 68000 absolute-jump opcode word followed by a 32-bit address copied from a table of longwords.

name: poll_until_result_ready
description: Stores its data register value with bit seven cleared into a global, then repeatedly calls a routine with a fixed argument of minus one, calling another routine between tries. It stops when the result is not minus one and a global byte is nonzero.

name: poll_result_minus_two
description: Stores its data register value with bit seven cleared into a global, then repeatedly calls a routine with a fixed argument of minus two, calling another routine between tries. It stops when the result is not minus one and a global byte is nonzero; its facts list the text ULTMAPS/SOSA.BIN, which the body does not show.

name: call_preserving_position_bytes
description: Saves the two position bytes of the record in two spare bytes and a global longword, calls one routine, then restores all three.

name: run_countdown_input_loop
description: Sets two record bytes to start values and the position fields to 24, then runs a countdown loop from 114750 that reads codes through routines and branches on them. The decompiled body is cut off partway in the bundle.

name: run_input_loop_with_branches
description: Enters the same countdown input loop, which reads codes through routines and branches on values such as 129, 138, 149 and 136, which change a direction index or step the position. Codes from 193 to 218 go through a switch, and the body is cut off partway in the bundle.

name: reset_position_decrement_countdown
description: Sets the position fields to 24 and decrements a countdown byte at offset 93 when it is nonzero, then reads a value through a routine and branches on it. A value of 1 clears a byte and runs a call loop, and a value of 2 runs a call sequence; the body is cut off partway in the bundle.

name: reset_position_with_countdown
description: Sets the position fields to 24 and decrements a countdown byte at offset 93 when it is nonzero, then branches on a value read through a routine. The body is cut off partway in the bundle.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Its own entry is two instructions that call one routine. The attached decompiled body is the larger loop shared by this code hunk, not the entry's own instructions.

name: test_input_bits_then_branch
description: Copies record bytes 0 and 1 into bytes 2 and 3, reads a code through a routine, and branches on whether byte 1 is negative and whether bit 5 of the code is set. The attached body is the shared dispatch loop of this hunk.

name: decrement_counter_if_bit_set
description: Copies the record's position bytes, reads a code through a routine, and when bit 4 of that code is set decrements the byte at offset 61. Otherwise it branches elsewhere; the attached body is the shared loop of this hunk.

name: restore_position_from_saved
description: Copies two saved bytes at offsets 77 and 78 back into the position bytes, sets offset 12 to 255 and offset 76 to zero, then calls several routines. The attached body is the shared loop of this hunk.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_if_nonzero
description: Decrements the BCD counter at offset 37 of the A5 record when it is nonzero, then calls routines. The attached body is the shared loop of this hunk.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_and_branch
description: Decrements the BCD counter at offset 37 of the A5 record when it is nonzero and otherwise falls through to further calls. It then tests the flag byte at offset 76 to choose a path; the attached body is the shared loop of this hunk.

name: store_bcd_decrement_of_argument
description: Stores the BCD-adjusted value of the data-register argument minus one into the counter at offset 37, then writes 10 and then 4 into a global byte and calls routines.

name: set_global_then_call
description: Calls one routine, writes 10 and then 4 into a global byte, and calls further routines, one of which resets the position bytes to 24.

name: reset_position_and_countdown
description: Sets the position bytes to 24 and decrements the countdown byte at offset 93 when it is nonzero, then calls routines. The attached body is the shared loop of this hunk.

name: clear_byte_then_call_loop
description: When the code in the data register equals 1, clears the byte at the start of the A5 record, calls several routines, and runs a loop of calls that exits on a constant test. The attached body is the shared loop of this hunk.

name: run_long_call_sequence
description: Runs a long sequence of routine calls with a loop whose exit test is constant. The attached body is the shared loop of this hunk, so only its call structure is visible here.

name: restore_saved_bytes_and_loop
description: In a loop, copies the two saved bytes at offsets 28 and 29 of the A5 record into offsets 26 and 27, calls routines, sets the position bytes to 24, and clears the byte at offset 76.

name: run_repeated_call_loop
description: Loops calling routines, sets the position bytes to 24, and continues until its exit test. The attached body is the shared loop of this hunk.

name: read_code_and_dispatch
description: Copies the position bytes, reads a code through a routine, and dispatches on it with several branches that call routines. The attached body is the shared dispatch loop of this hunk.

name: return_power_of_two
description: Returns 1 shifted left by the value in the low byte of data register D2, which is two raised to that count, computed with a loop.

name: lookup_table_index_from_position
description: Builds a 16-bit index from the byte at offset 61 and the position bytes, then returns the global table byte at that index, with offset 61 in the high byte of the result.

name: xor_scramble_global_buffer
description: Walks a 2048-byte global buffer, XORing each byte with a key byte from record offset 45 while passing three record bytes at offsets 42 to 44 through a small shift chain. It returns once the count passes 2047.

name: clear_global_and_spin
description: Writes zero to a global byte, then spins while that byte is nonzero, so it returns once the byte reads zero.

name: store_byte_to_global
description: Stores the low byte of the data register into a global byte, writing it twice.

name: repeat_while_result_one
description: Calls two routines, then repeatedly calls one routine and another routine while the first returns one, and returns.

name: dispatch_state_codes
description: Sets a state word to 4 and waits for a routine result of 2, then dispatches on a second state word: value 1 returns 1, value 2 leaves the loop, and value 3 updates a global bit before repeating.

name: set_global_bits_and_call
description: Sets bits 0, 1 and 2 in a global byte, calling a routine for each bit that was previously clear. Bit 2 is set only when record byte 75 is nonzero, and further routines are called depending on the branches that follow.

name: xor_record_byte_into_global
description: The decompiled output for this entry is only two statements: it XORs record byte 44 into a global byte and clears a global word. The entry's 148 instructions are not represented in that output.

name: store_decremented_argument_word
description: Stores its data-register argument minus one into a global word, then calls one routine.

name: initialise_record_defaults
description: Sets record bytes at offsets 76, 74, 79, 77 and 78 to 0, 126, 255, 44 and 20, calls one routine when byte 75 is nonzero, and sets a global word to 1.

name: begin_state_and_wait
description: Sets a state word to 3 and stores its data-register argument in another global, calls three routines, then repeatedly calls a routine until it returns 2. It returns the state word.

name: wait_result_two_return_state
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until it returns 2, then returns the state word from a global.

name: cycle_vertical_position_with_wrap
description: Sets two record bytes to 1, then loops setting the horizontal position to 1 and computing the vertical position from a record byte plus 12. It subtracts 10 when the vertical position passes 22, sets the horizontal position to 20 at that wrap, and calls routines on each pass. No text is referenced.

name: initialise_state_and_run_loop
description: Clears several state words and bytes, sets one state word to 30, calls routines, and then enters an endless loop of routine calls.

name: store_flagged_entry_at_index
description: References the text 'Create Character'. It sets the horizontal position to 14, calls routines 13 times, then stores a global byte into an indexed table entry with bit seven set, and calls routines again.

name: call_then_set_fixed_position
description: Calls one routine, sets the horizontal position to 17 and the vertical position to 9, calls another routine, and returns.

name: call_once_then_string_bytes
description: Calls one routine once, then calls it for each byte of a zero-terminated string at the address in address register four, stopping at the terminating zero. It returns zero.

name: call_per_string_byte
description: For each byte of a zero-terminated string at the address in address register four, calls one routine, stopping at the terminating zero. It then returns zero.

name: call_at_stepped_rows
description: Repeatedly sets the horizontal position to 14 and increments the vertical position by one, calling a routine at each step over several rows starting from row 1.

name: find_byte_or_walk_string
description: If the data register byte is nonzero, scans the string at the address in address register zero for that byte and calls a routine with the result. Otherwise it calls a routine for each byte of a global zero-terminated string. The referenced texts are 'Create Character' and 'Select'.

name: find_byte_in_string
description: Advances through the string at the address in address register zero until it finds the byte in data register one, then calls one routine and returns.

name: step_counter_on_code_input
description: Sets a global longword, sets the vertical position to 1 and the horizontal position from a global counter plus 14, then branches on a code in a global byte. Code 141 ends the step, while code 136 calls a routine, decrements the counter, and clears a global bit when the counter reaches zero.

name: call_then_increment_x_position
description: Calls one routine, then adds one to the horizontal position byte of the record.

name: multiply_low_byte_by_64
description: Returns the low byte of its data-register argument multiplied by 64, computed as a shift.

name: copy_sixteen_bytes
description: Copies 16 bytes from the address in address register zero to the address in address register one.

name: set_state_pointers_for_index
description: Stores pointer and word values computed from the data-register argument, choosing between two branches at the value 7. It saves the previous state word and sets the state word to 5 at the end.

name: walk_entries_for_input_hits
description: Copies two snapshot words into current values, then unless a flag byte's high bit is set, walks a null-terminated list of entries selected by the state word and calls routines for entries whose first byte is not 2. The facts list a CIA port register (fire buttons and disk status) that the body reads through the called routines.

name: arm_flag_then_call
description: If a global counter is zero, sets it to minus one and calls one routine. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: disarm_flag_then_call
description: If a global counter is nonzero, sets it to zero and calls one routine. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: set_bounds_from_record_bytes
description: Stores record bytes 0 and 1, each plus one, as a pair of global words, and bytes 2 and 3, each minus one, as two other global words, then calls one routine.

name: set_bounds_from_record_bytes
description: Stores record bytes 0 and 1, each plus one, as a pair of global words, and bytes 2 and 3, each minus one, as two other global words, then calls one routine.

name: walk_pointer_list_calling_routine
description: Loads a state word from a list entry at offset 10, calls one routine, then walks a zero-terminated list of longwords starting 12 bytes into that entry. It stops at the first entry that is not minus one, calls one routine for it, and returns.

name: dispatch_on_two_low_bits
description: Tests bit 1 of the data-register argument and calls one routine when it is set; within that case, bit 0 selects further calls. It then makes several more calls.

name: adjust_global_words_by_argument
description: Adds the data-register argument to some global words and subtracts it from others, then copies a longword into another global.

name: parse_entry_code_and_return
description: Reads the first word of a list entry at the address in address register four and returns 1 for code 1 or 3 for code 3. Other codes call routines and advance through the entry, copying a byte into the record; the referenced text is 'Create Character'.

name: skip_n_bytes_in_pointer
description: When the data-register argument is nonzero, advances the address in address register four past that many bytes, one at a time, and returns.

name: copy_pair_words_to_globals
description: Copies two words from the address in address register zero into two pairs of global words, then calls one routine.

name: call_three_then_four_times
description: Calls one routine three times in straight line, then calls it four more times in a loop, and returns.

name: call_once_then_four_times
description: Calls one routine once, then calls it four times in a loop, and returns.

name: copy_snapshot_words_to_globals
description: Copies a small block of longwords and words from the address in address register zero into a set of global words, then returns.

name: call_draw_with_coordinates
description: Calls the _Draw routine with a global base address and the two data-register values as arguments, then returns.

name: call_move_with_coordinates
description: Calls the _Move routine with the address of a global block and the two data-register values as arguments, then returns.

name: set_pen_from_global
description: Calls the _SetAPen routine with the address of a global block as its argument, then returns.

name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the length of the destination string, then copies the source string bytes to its end up to the terminating zero. It returns the destination pointer, in the style of a string concatenation.

name: append_bounded_string
description: Appends at most the given count of characters from the source string to the end of the destination, stopping at the source's terminating zero. It then writes a terminating zero and returns the destination pointer.

name: format_printf_style_string
description: Walks a format string, copying ordinary characters and handling percent sequences, with a doubled percent written as a single percent. It reads values from the argument list and calls two other routines to handle conversions.

name: save_state_set_port_bit
description: Copies 20 bytes of a global block into the buffer passed in, then updates bits of a global mirror of a CIA port register using a bit mask derived from the second argument.

name: update_port_mirror_from_record
description: Recomputes a global CIA port value from two bytes read through the argument pointer, combining the inverted first byte with the inverted second byte shifted to bit seven, and sets bit seven.

name: set_port_mask_bits_120
description: Sets the bits selected by the decimal mask 120 in a global CIA port value, then returns.

name: wait_quarter_count_iterations
description: Shifts its argument right by two and calls one routine once per remaining count, as a timed wait loop.

name: start_flagged_action_once
description: Returns zero if the flag byte at offset 1 of the argument is already set. Otherwise it sets the flag, calls one routine twice with the argument, then calls another routine with 500000 as its argument and returns that result.

name: set_flag_run_action_wait
description: Sets byte 1 of the structure that the frame slot points to, calls routines with it, and calls one routine with 500000 as a timed wait.

name: set_port_bit_zero_wait
description: Sets bit 0 of a global CIA port value and calls one routine with 3000 as its argument, as a timed wait.

name: run_port_handshake_sequence
description: Clears a word in the structure, clears bit 1 and sets bit 2 of a global port value, then loops calling routines and waiting with 15000 until a port bit condition changes. It accesses CIA port A and CIA port B.

name: wait_port_bit_then_pause
description: Sets bit 1 of a global port value, then loops while bit 4 of that value is clear, calling a routine and waiting with 15000 on each pass.

name: pause_then_call_routine
description: Calls one routine with 15000 as its argument as a timed pause, then calls another routine with the structure's frame value and returns.

name: update_step_parity_bits
description: When the word stored at offset 6 of the structure differs from the argument, sets or clears a bit of a global port value from the argument's parity, then calls a routine with 200 as a delay. It returns zero when the values are equal.

name: update_port_bits_from_deltas
description: Compares two stored values in the structure. It sets or clears port bits 1 and 2 according to their order and calls a routine with 200 as a delay when the first pair differs.

name: step_port_bits_by_difference
description: Sets port bit 2 and calls a routine with 200 as a delay, then compares two stored values and sets or clears bit 1 according to their order. It stores their difference in the structure and loops over calls while that difference is nonzero.

name: repeat_step_pulses_by_count
description: Sets port bit 1 and loads a countdown from the difference of two stored values. It loops that many times, calling a routine and waiting with 15000 on each pass, and updates a word in the structure on each pass.

name: wait_store_word_then_call
description: Waits with 15000 as a timed pause, copies the low word of the longword at offset 12 of the frame structure into the word at offset 6, then calls one routine.

name: start_transfer_with_timeout
description: Writes the structure's address to a custom chip register and sets another register, then counts down from 200000 while checking a port bit. It returns 22 when the countdown runs out.

name: poll_transfer_status_words
description: Loops reading a 16-bit status word at offset 30 of a referenced block into the structure. When a flag bit is set it clears a word at offset 36, and while a port bit is clear it sets a countdown to 25, calls a routine, and returns 25.

name: clear_flag_and_call_result
description: Returns zero if the flag byte at offset 1 of the argument is clear. Otherwise it clears the flag, calls one routine, and returns the result of a second call.

name: clear_flag_and_call_twice
description: Clears byte 1 of the structure that the frame slot points to, then calls two routines with it as the argument.

name: write_custom_enable_bits
description: Sets the top two bits of the argument, giving the value 49152 or above, and writes it to a custom chip register.

name: search_packed_nibble_entries
description: Splits its third argument into a count and a four-bit remainder, then scans bytes from the buffer at the second argument for the byte in the first argument. It returns the position on a match, or minus one when the count is used up.

name: scan_word_block_for_match
description: Loops over a counted block of 16-bit words, advancing two bytes at a time and comparing each with a stored word. It returns the position of a match, or a status when the count runs out.

name: resume_word_block_scan
description: Resumes the word-block scan from the stored pointer, reading the next word and comparing it with a stored word. It returns the stored value on a match and advances the count otherwise.

name: shift_and_match_bit_stream
description: Advances the pointer by one word and checks a counter against a limit, returning minus one at the limit. Otherwise it builds a shifted bit window from the next word and loops comparing its top word with a stored word.

name: shift_bit_window_and_match
description: Builds a shifted bit window from the next word and the data register, then loops shifting it and comparing its top word with a stored word. It returns the stored longword on a match and advances the bit position on each shift.

name: advance_bit_position_by_word
description: Shifts a bit window one place and advances a bit position, moving to the next 16-bit word when the position reaches sixteen. It calls routines as it crosses word boundaries.

name: load_word_and_match_window
description: Adds the next 16-bit word to the data register, then shifts the window left and compares its top word with a stored word, returning the stored longword on a match.

name: allocate_buffer_and_initialise
description: Allocates a 28400-byte block through the system allocator and returns 1 if that fails. Otherwise it initialises a global, calls several routines, and runs a timed call with the constants 37450 and 14200.

name: setup_buffer_and_run_transfer
description: Calls a routine whose result is stored in the structure, initialises a global, runs several calls with a block address from the structure, then performs a timed transfer call and returns a status.

name: check_block_progress_within_limit
description: Calls a routine with a block address offset by 16 and the constant 14200, returning 3 when that call fails. It then subtracts 110000 from the difference of two stored values and branches on whether the result is within the limit.

name: free_block_if_within_limit
description: Computes the difference of two stored values and subtracts 110000 from it. When the result is greater than minus 3001, it frees the 28400-byte block allocated earlier and returns zero; otherwise it returns 4.

name: decrement_digit_field_bounded
description: Decrements a value returned by a routine and stores it at record offset 98. It compares the result with the byte at offset 75 to choose a path, which calls routines and stores a second decremented value at offset 99.

name: store_decremented_slot_values
description: Decrements an input byte and stores it at record offset 98, checks it against the byte at offset 75, and stores a second decremented value at offset 99 when in range. It copies the first value to offset 102 when they differ, references the text 'PLR:-', and calls seven routines.

name: branch_on_mode_byte_values
description: Branches on the record's mode byte at offset 76: zero, one, 128, and values below two each take different paths that call routines and test the first two record bytes.

name: reset_horizontal_position_and_call
description: Sets the horizontal position byte of the record to 24 and calls one routine.

name: enter_shared_dispatch_loop
description: Five-instruction entry that calls routines and then branches into the shared dispatch code of this hunk, which tests the mode byte at offset 76 and the first two record bytes. The attached body is that shared code.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_set_ten
description: When the BCD counter at offset 39 of the A5 record is nonzero, decrements it and sets the byte at offset 92 to 10. Otherwise it joins the shared dispatch code of this hunk.

name: start_code_decode_loop
description: Sets the byte at offset 118 to 255, calls routines, and sets a decode counter at offset 30 to 8 before entering a nested loop that reads codes. The attached body is the shared decode code of this hunk.

name: decode_codes_with_counter
description: After setting the decode counter at offset 30 to 8, reads codes in a nested loop. Code 141 leaves the loop, and code 136 moves the horizontal position back and increments the counter while the counter is seven or less.

name: decode_codes_with_counter_entry
description: Enters the same counter-based code decoder with the decode counter set to 8. Code 141 ends the loop, and code 136 moves the horizontal position back while the counter is seven or less.

name: decode_codes_store_last_code
description: Sets the decode counter at offset 30 to 8 and runs the code loop, storing the last code read at offset 31. It references the text 'CMD:-'.

name: store_code_and_advance
description: For codes from 192 to 218, stores the code at offset 31, advances the horizontal position, and decrements the decode counter, then calls routines. Other codes join the shared code.

name: match_key_pair_set_flag
description: When the codes are 199 and 5, checks the record's mode byte and two byte pairs, and sets a flag byte at offset 63 or 47 of the A5 record for the matching pair. Routines are called around the check.

name: store_flag_for_code_pair
description: When the codes are 200 and 2 and record byte 6 equals 124, stores a routine result at offset 105 and ORs it into the A5 record byte at offset 14. Other code pairs, such as 197, are handled in the shared code.

name: check_available_memory_on_code
description: For code 197 with argument 4, calls the system available-memory routine with the argument 2, runs a loop of four routine calls, and otherwise joins the shared code.

name: check_available_memory_loop
description: When the second code is 4, calls the system available-memory routine with 2, runs a loop of four calls, and then joins the shared code.

name: match_code_217_with_record
description: When the codes are 217 and 4, checks several record bytes against each other and against fixed values, then calls routines. Code 197 with other conditions takes a second branch.

name: toggle_record_byte_pair
description: When code 197 arrives with argument 1 and the flag conditions hold, toggles the record byte at offset 1 between 56 and 59, then calls routines.

name: branch_on_mode_byte_entry
description: Entry into the shared dispatch code, which branches on the mode byte at offset 76 and then on the first two record bytes. The attached body is the shared code.

name: map_direction_code_to_index
description: When the first code is 124, maps a following code from a set of four onto values 30 to 33, storing that index at offset 106 and the next code at offset 105. It references the text 'DIR-'.

name: map_action_code_test_flag
description: Maps one of four codes to values 30 to 33 and stores it at offset 106, reads a value into offset 105, and tests it against the A5 record byte at offset 14 to choose a path. It references the text 'D, S, L, M-'.

name: match_slot_then_run_loop
description: Stores its data-register argument at offset 106 and reads a value into offset 105. When that value overlaps the A5 flag byte at offset 14 and offset 106 matches two record bytes, it increments the byte at offset 25 and runs a loop of calls that writes 240 and 124 into the A5 record.

name: increment_slot_and_run_loop
description: When the byte at offset 106 matches two record bytes, increments the byte at offset 25, sets offset 97 to 4, and runs a loop of calls writing 240 and 124 into the A5 record.

name: compare_slot_then_run_loop
description: When the data-register byte equals the byte at offset 25, increments that byte, sets offset 97 to 4, and runs the same loop of calls writing 240 and 124 into the A5 record.

name: call_routine_when_global_matches
description: Calls several routines, and when a global byte equals minus 98 it calls a further routine at a fixed address before the remaining calls. Otherwise it follows the other path.

name: call_fixed_address_then_loop
description: Calls routines, calls a routine at a fixed address, then runs a loop of calls. The attached body is the shared loop of this hunk.

name: repeat_call_until_exit
description: Runs a loop calling one routine until its exit test is met, which is constant in the visible code.

name: store_flag_on_byte_match
description: When record byte 6 equals 124, stores a routine result at offset 105 and ORs it into the A5 record byte at offset 14. Otherwise it joins the shared code.

name: or_routine_result_into_flag
description: Stores a routine result at offset 105, ORs it into the A5 record byte at offset 14, and then joins the shared code.
